Getting started

Install in under a minute

Chrome doesn't have this in the Web Store yet, so it loads as an unpacked extension. It only takes three steps.

  1. 01

    Download & unzip

    Grab the ZIP above, then unzip it anywhere on your computer — you'll point Chrome at that folder next.

  2. 02

    Turn on developer mode

    Open chrome://extensions in a new tab and flip the Developer mode toggle in the top-right corner.

  3. 03

    Load unpacked

    Click Load unpacked and select the unzipped folder. The extension appears in your toolbar right away.

YouTube Focus Extension Open source · free to run

Before you install

This isn't on the Chrome Web Store, so Chrome needs the unzipped folder, not the zip itself. Quick heads up before you download:

  1. 1Unzip the file after it downloads — don't open the zip and drag files out, or Chrome won't find manifest.json.
  2. 2Go to chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode
  3. 3Click Load unpacked and select the unzipped folder — the one with manifest.json directly inside it.
